# iaas_vpn_ipsec_connection (Resource)

Manages an IPsec site-to-site connection (IKEv2 or IKEv1, pre-shared key) of a VPN gateway. A connection is a child of an iaas_vpn_gateway: its parent vpn_gateway_id is part of the API path, so changing it forces a new resource. Everything else, including the pre-shared key, can be changed in place. Writes are recorded at once and applied to the gateway asynchronously (the first connection also installs the IPsec packages in the gateway): create and update wait until apply_state is "applied" and fail when the gateway reports "failed". The live tunnel (sa_state) depends on the remote peer and is not waited for. Delete waits until the gateway has confirmed the removal. The values to enter on the other device are available in the computed remote_settings attribute. The optional text attributes remote_address, local_id, remote_id, ike_proposal and esp_proposal cannot be empty or padded with whitespace (the platform would store an empty string as null); remove the attribute to leave it unset or to clear it. Import with a composite id: "<gateway_id>/<connection_id>".

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An IPsec site-to-site connection is a CHILD of a VPN gateway: it joins the
# gateway's VPC to a remote network (an office router, a firewall, another cloud)
# over IKEv2 with a pre-shared key. The first connection on a gateway also
# installs the IPsec packages in the gateway, so the first apply takes longer.

# Assumes an existing, active iaas_vpn_gateway. See examples/resources/iaas_vpn_gateway.
variable "vpn_gateway_id" {
  type = string
}

# The pre-shared key is a secret: pass it in through a sensitive variable, never
# a literal. 16 to 128 printable ASCII characters, no spaces, double quotes or
# backslashes.
variable "office_psk" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "iaas_vpn_ipsec_connection" "office" {
  # Parent gateway id - part of the API path. Changing this forces a new resource.
  vpn_gateway_id = var.vpn_gateway_id

  name           = "office-hq"
  remote_address = "198.51.100.7"

  # WRITE-ONLY and sensitive: stored encrypted by the platform and never returned,
  # so it cannot be read back or recovered on import. Changing it updates the key
  # in place; it does not replace the connection.
  psk = var.office_psk

  # Networks reachable through the tunnel. They must not overlap the VPC, the
  # tunnel subnet, WireGuard peers, VPC peerings or other IPsec connections.
  remote_ts = ["192.168.50.0/24"]

  # Everything below is optional. Defaults: the whole VPC range as local_ts,
  # IKEv2, the "modern" proposal preset, initiator role, dead-peer detection every
  # 30 seconds, UDP encapsulation on.
  # local_ts          = ["10.60.0.0/16"]
  # proposal_preset   = "modern"
  # role              = "initiator"
  # udp_encapsulation = true
}

# create and update wait until the gateway has applied the change
# (apply_state = "applied"); the live tunnel (sa_state) depends on the remote
# device and is not waited for. The values to enter on the other device are in
# remote_settings (a JSON document).
output "office_our_public_ip" {
  value = jsondecode(iaas_vpn_ipsec_connection.office.remote_settings).our_public_ip
}

output "office_tunnel_state" {
  value = iaas_vpn_ipsec_connection.office.sa_state
}

# A responder that waits for a peer which identifies itself by name (the peer may
# have a dynamic address):
#
# resource "iaas_vpn_ipsec_connection" "roadside" {
#   vpn_gateway_id = var.vpn_gateway_id
#   name           = "branch-dynamic"
#   role           = "responder"
#   remote_id_type = "fqdn"
#   remote_id      = "branch.example.com"
#   psk            = var.branch_psk
#   remote_ts      = ["192.168.60.0/24"]
# }

# Import with the COMPOSITE id "<gateway_id>/<connection_id>", e.g.:
#   terraform import iaas_vpn_ipsec_connection.office 22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/88888888-8888-8888-8888-888888888888
# (psk cannot be recovered on import - set it in config; the next apply sends it.)
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name: 2 to 32 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit, unique per gateway. Never sent to the gateway.
- `psk` (String, Sensitive) Pre-shared key: 16 to 128 printable ASCII characters without spaces, double quotes or backslashes. Sensitive and write-only: it is stored encrypted by the platform and never returned, so it cannot be read back or recovered on import (set it in configuration after an import; the next apply sends it). Changing it updates the key in place and re-negotiates the tunnel; it does not replace the connection. If the key is changed outside Terraform (detected through the platform's key version) the next plan shows an update that sets it back to the configured value.
- `remote_ts` (Set of String) Remote networks reachable through the tunnel (IPv4 CIDRs with a /8 to /32 prefix, 1 to 32 of them). They must not overlap any other destination of the gateway (its VPC, tunnel subnet, WireGuard peers, VPC peerings or other IPsec connections); a removed connection keeps its networks reserved until the gateway has confirmed the removal.
- `vpn_gateway_id` (String) UUID of the parent VPN gateway. Part of the API request path, so changing it forces a new resource. The gateway must be active.

### Optional

- `child_lifetime` (Number) Child SA lifetime in seconds, 300 to 28800 and not above ike_lifetime. Defaults to 3600.
- `dpd_action` (String) What to do when the peer stops answering: "clear", "trap" or "restart". Defaults to "restart" for an initiator and "clear" for a responder.
- `dpd_delay` (Number) Dead-peer-detection interval in seconds, 0 to 300 (0 disables it). Defaults to 30.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connection is enabled (loaded on the gateway). Defaults to true.
- `esp_proposal` (String) ESP proposal list for proposal_preset = "custom", for example "aes256gcm16-ecp384". Must be unset for the other presets.
- `ike_lifetime` (Number) IKE SA lifetime in seconds, 600 to 86400. Defaults to 14400.
- `ike_proposal` (String) IKE proposal list for proposal_preset = "custom", for example "aes256gcm16-prfsha384-ecp384". Must be unset for the other presets.
- `ike_version` (Number) IKE version, 1 or 2. Defaults to 2. IKEv1 needs proposal_preset = "compat" and a remote_address.
- `local_id` (String) Local identity value matching local_id_type. Defaults to the gateway public IP when omitted.
- `local_id_type` (String) How this side identifies itself: "address", "fqdn", "email" or "keyid". Defaults to "address" (the gateway public IP).
- `local_ts` (Set of String) Local networks exposed through the tunnel: the VPC range or one or more of its subnets (IPv4 CIDRs, at most 16). Defaults to the whole VPC range.
- `proposal_preset` (String) Cipher proposal preset: "modern" (default), "compat" (older devices, needed for IKEv1) or "custom" (requires ike_proposal and esp_proposal).
- `remote_address` (String) Public IPv4 address or host name of the remote peer. Omit only for a responder (role = "responder") that identifies the peer by fqdn, email, keyid or any (IKEv2 only).
- `remote_id` (String) Remote identity value matching remote_id_type. Defaults to remote_address when omitted.
- `remote_id_type` (String) How the remote peer identifies itself: "address", "fqdn", "email", "keyid" or "any" (any is for a responder only). Defaults to "address".
- `role` (String) "initiator" (this gateway starts the tunnel; the default) or "responder" (it waits for the peer).
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `udp_encapsulation` (Boolean) Use UDP encapsulation (only udp/500 and udp/4500). Defaults to true. Turning it off needs raw ESP (IP protocol 50), which security groups cannot admit; the platform warns when security groups are attached.

### Read-Only

- `apply_state` (String) Whether the gateway has applied the latest change: pending, applied or failed. Create and update wait for applied.
- `conn_name` (String) Technical connection name used on the gateway (vc- followed by 12 hex digits).
- `id` (String) UUID of the connection, assigned by the API.
- `last_error` (String) Text of the last tunnel error observed on the gateway (null when none).
- `last_error_code` (String) Machine code of the last tunnel error observed on the gateway, for example authentication_failed, no_proposal_chosen, ts_unacceptable or peer_unreachable (null when none).
- `remote_settings` (String) The values to enter on the other device, as a JSON document (use jsondecode()): our_public_ip, our_identity, your_identity, ike_version, ike_proposals, esp_proposals, local_networks, remote_networks, ike_lifetime, child_lifetime, pfs, dpd, nat_traversal, instance_route_hint and vendor_notes. It never contains the pre-shared key. Refreshed on every read; a failure to fetch it is a warning, not an error.
- `sa_state` (String) Live tunnel state: unknown, down, connecting, partial (IKE up, a child SA missing), or established. It depends on the remote peer and is refreshed on every read.

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
